description: This is a PHP unit test class for testing the ProjectDao functions in the OrangeHRM time tracking plugin. It includes setup for test fixtures, and multiple test cases for CRUD operations, filtering, report generation, and access control on Project entities.

classes.name: ProjectDaoTest
classes.description: PHP unit test class for ProjectDao, testing project CRUD, filtering, reporting, and access control
